description: Read whether your workspace explores prices: learned and optimizer prices for the same product then vary slightly from call to call, by up to the rate either way (steered toward the best price, at most 10%, once enough is learned), so Last Price can learn what buyers will pay. Never below cost and always inside your price guardrails. Shows whether it is on and why, the rate, and the bounds. Needs a Last Price credential with routing read scope.
name: get_price_exploration
